title: Features of using mobile applications to identify plants and Google Lens during the learning process
reason: Evaluates plant-identification apps: recognition accuracy on 350 plant images and an expert survey on usability for biology classes. No student sample (experts and app tests only); no LMS indicator related to learning success or traits.

extraction.design: app accuracy test plus expert survey
extraction.population: experts in digital didactics; no students
extraction.outcome_or_construct: app recognition accuracy; expert usability ratings
extraction.notes: Recognition rates 71–92.6% are app accuracies, not learner indicators. CEUR-style conference paper (ICHTML 2025 co-located workshop). Could equally be coded NOREL.
